name: dhis2-chap
description: Internal Claude Code plugins for the DHIS2 CHAP modeling platform.

plugins.name: hello-world
plugins.description: Example plugin — a starting template with one slash command and one skill.

plugins.name: improve-chap-model
plugins.description: Iteratively improve an existing CHAP model: evaluate with the chap CLI, tune code/config, and track every experiment with git for reproducibility.

plugins.name: discourse
plugins.description: Set up and use the Discourse MCP server against the DHIS2 Community of Practice (community.dhis2.org): search and read topics, draft release announcements and replies in the Chap category.

plugins.name: convert-to-chapkit
plugins.description: Convert an existing CHAP model repo (MLproject plus train/predict scripts, Python or R) into a chapkit 2.x ML service, gated on numeric parity with the pre-conversion predictions.
